INTRODUCTION TO CAI
To view new information press the Enter key on your keyboard or select the Next arrow using the mouse.
To view previous information press the Left Arrow key on your keyboard or select the Back arrow using the mouse.
To view available function keys press F1.
*Note: The Left Arrow key is available in this lesson only.
OBJECTIVES
1. Computer Communication
* Learn how the mouse is used in a CAI lesson.
* Learn how the keyboard is used in a CAI lesson.
2. Types of Pages
* Identify lesson page types.
* Become familiar with lesson structure.
EQUIPMENT REQUIRED
1. IBM PC Compatible Computer
INTRODUCTION
Congratulations on your decision to use Computer Assisted Instruction (CAI). CAI is like having your own private teacher.
The lessons are interesting and learning is exciting with CAI.
Let's begin the lesson on INTRODUCTION TO CAI.
